description: Read the person’s routines: the questions RoBot answers again by itself, on a schedule or when something happens. Each with its id, name, kind, when it runs (and its next run), whether it’s on, where its note goes (bell, Discord, email), how many times it’s run and its last run, and its question. This only reads; routine creates and changes them. Opens with RoBot: an account RoBot isn’t open on yet gets not_available.
name: routines
title: Your routines
